Quarles Adds AI and Data Governance Partner Megan Bowman to Minneapolis Office

  • November 9, 2026
  • 1:43 pm
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

MINNEAPOLIS, MN—Quarles & Brady today announced that Megan Bowman has joined the firm’s Minneapolis office as a partner in the Intellectual Property Practice Group.

Bowman advises on the full artificial intelligence (AI) lifecycle, from conception and development through deployment, commercialization and exit. She counsels clients on all aspects of AI development, procurement and deployment, including training data rights and provenance, licensing and ownership, consumer protection compliance, and AI governance frameworks and internal controls.
